options: Route the record to routine restoration capacity monitoring
Route the record to restoration capacity expansion follow-up

O.content: The vertical axis is labeled “Capacity Index,” with printed tick labels increasing upward from 0 near the bottom to 2,800 near the top.
The blue line’s mark at 2023 is lower on the page than its mark at 2018.

B.text: If the vertical axis encodes Capacity Index with larger values higher on the page, and overall trend is assessed by comparing the first and last plotted years, a final mark lower than the initial mark indicates a decline; if decline maps to the decline-response route, select that route.
B.conditions: Applies if the plotted endpoints, rather than the chart title or intermediate peak, define the overall trend; the decline-to-route mapping is inferred from the option wording.

O.content: The blue line is nearly horizontal from 2021 to 2022 and slopes only slightly downward from 2022 to 2023.

B.text: If the vertical axis encodes Capacity Index with larger values higher on the page, and the latest multi-year segment is treated as approximately stable despite small movement, the routine-monitoring route may fit a stable recent trend.
B.conditions: Applies only if routing is based on recent stability rather than the full 2018-2023 period; no explicit stability threshold is supplied.

O.content: The printed title reads “Increasing River Restoration Capacity from 2018 to 2023”.

B.text: If the dashboard title is an intended descriptor of the overall 2018-2023 capacity trend, and the routing task maps an increasing overall capacity trend to expansion follow-up, select the expansion-follow-up route.
B.conditions: Applies only if the title is authoritative for the requested overall trend rather than merely descriptive; the task provides no explicit routing policy table.
